lines.text: James writes to the twelve tribes and tells them to count trials as pure joy, since testing develops perseverance.
Anyone lacking wisdom should ask a teacher, who gives generously, but the doubter is like a wave tossed by the wind.
The humble brother should exult in his high position, and the rich should exult in his low position because he will pass away like a flower.
The man who perseveres under trial and stands the test will receive the crown of glory promised to those who love God.
God tempts no one, and each person is tempted by his own desires, which give birth to sin and then death.
